responsibility: Main public interface for GCC’s RTL dataflow subsystem. It defines problem IDs and directions, df_ref classes/types/flags, the key problem and block-info accessors, APIs for scanning, solving, simulating, rescanning, dumping, and querying dataflow results, and convenience helpers for common queries such as live-in/live-out, artificial refs, single defs/uses, and union-find support used by web construction.
